name: continuity
description: Never lose context when switching AI assistants. Continuity silently tracks your edits and auto-copies a structured handoff prompt the moment you open a different AI chat panel.

continuity.offlineMode.description: Disable all network calls. AI extraction and enrichment are skipped.

continuity.capture.enabled.description: Capture workspace file edits while a Continuity session is active.

continuity.capture.maxDiffChars.description: Maximum number of characters stored for a single file diff.

continuity.capture.flushIntervalMs.description: Debounce interval (ms) before persisting a captured file edit.

continuity.prompt.maxChars.description: Maximum character budget for generated handoff prompts.

continuity.session.autoStart.description: Automatically start a rolling session when VS Code opens.

continuity.session.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Reserved for future idle-rotation behaviour. Currently informational.

continuity.session.autoHandoffOnAssistan.description: Automatically copy a handoff prompt to the clipboard when you switch AI assistant panels.

continuity.ai.enrichHandoff.description: Enrich auto-handoffs and snapshots with AI-inferred goal, decisions, assumptions, and pending items.

continuity.ai.autoExtractOnSnapshot.description: Automatically run AI extraction when you save a context snapshot.

continuity.ai.serviceUrl.description: Override the Continuity extraction service URL (leave blank to use the default).

scripts.test: tsc -p ./ && node --test out/test/parseExtraction.test.js out/test/promptEngine.test.js out/test/enrichment.test.js out/test/decisionCapture.test.js out/test/workspaceIsolation.test.js out/test/backgroundEnricher.test.js
